Who need IE code registration? All persons seeking to import and export goods and services into and from India, will have to register for the IE Code. Does IE Code has option for the Individual? Yes, Individual running a proprietorship business enterprise may obtain IE Code. What is time frame for procuring IE code registration? IE Code Registration can be obtained from the DGFT within 10-15 working days after submitting all the necessary documents and applications. What is the consequences of not having an IE Code? IE Code is not essential for all, but it is necessary for importers and exporters of goods or services. So, there is no fine charged if anybody does not possess the IE Code but without it you cannot import or export. Is there any tax involved with IE Code? No, IE Code is not a tax registration, so no taxes are levied based on IE Code at the time of importing or exporting goods or services. However, custom duty is levied.

sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: The IEC, which stands for Importer Exporter Code, is a special 10-digit code issued by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. It is given to a business based on their PAN (Permanent Account Number). If an individual or a business wants to do international trade, then IEC registration is necessary.

An Importer-Exporter Code (IEC) is really important if you want to bring things into India or send them out. It is like a special ID number for your import or export business. Since overseas transactions are considered as business activity. Hence, it must be adhered to the regulations of the government. In India, it is the Importer-Exporter Code that is necessary for businesses involved in foreign trade.

The IEC, which stands for Importer Exporter Code, is a special 10-digit code issued by the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. It is given to a business based on their PAN (Permanent Account Number). If an individual or a business wants to do international trade, then IEC registration is necessary.

Business Expansion: The Import Export Code registration is the one needed by an import-export business, enabling a person to enter into the international market and, in this way, improving and progressing the business-standard.
A number of advantages: Companies can enjoy various benefits related to their imports and exports through their IEC registration, such as benefits from DGFT, Export Promotion Council, Customs, etc.

No Return Filing: IEC doesn't require any kind of return filing. Once you have it, you do not have to follow any special process to retain its validity. Even for the export transactions, you need not to file any return with DGFT.

Control illegal trade: In order to obtain an IEC Registration, one has to provide valid and accurate information. The department will not issue an IEC registration without receiving complete and accurate information, thus limiting the illegal trade of goods.
No Renewal Required: An IEC code is effective for the lifetime of your business and does not require renewal. Once obtained, it can be used for all export and import transactions.
These are some of the documents you need to submit for license of import-export.
PAN Card of company or firm
Voter ID, Aadhaar card or passport copy of the Proprietor
Proof of incorporation or registration of the partnership, society, proprietorship firm, or company etc. It is necessary to apply for IEC code
Proof of address of the business, like sale deed, lease deed, rent agreement or utility bills, such as electricity bill, telephone bill or water bill.
Cancel cheque copies of bank accounts of company or firm.
Step 1: Go to the website of DGFT.

Who need IE code registration?
All persons seeking to import and export goods and services into and from India, will have to register for the IE Code.
Does IE Code has option for the Individual?
Yes, Individual running a proprietorship business enterprise may obtain IE Code.
What is time frame for procuring IE code registration?
IE Code Registration can be obtained from the DGFT within 10-15 working days after submitting all the necessary documents and applications.
What is the consequences of not having an IE Code?

IE Code is not essential for all, but it is necessary for importers and exporters of goods or services. So, there is no fine charged if anybody does not possess the IE Code but without it you cannot import or export.
Is there any tax involved with IE Code?
No, IE Code is not a tax registration, so no taxes are levied based on IE Code at the time of importing or exporting goods or services. However, custom duty is levied.
